text:
deploy-bot: scheduled v2 midnight cutover (00:00 UTC) — progressive ramp across slices: 1% -> 8% -> 20% over 45m. Features: header normalization, streaming boundary reassembler, chunked-keepalive tweak. Pinlists in effect: tenant-exclude.csv, critical-enterprise.csv

mike: FYI — scheduling note: some long-running dedicated customers hit through-proxies that rewrite headers. We should be ready to pin quickly.

tara: confirmed. staging found one proxy that strips 'content-type' when header keys are lowercased. that's the root cause for partial responses. we have a focused patch for the reassembler queued.

sanjay: telemetry snapshot: long-context tenants (ids: northstar, peregrine) exercise the new codepath more. staging repro for 'northstar' showed 0.6% 5xx at 00:12 UTC on long-poll streams.

ops-jen: monitor rule: auto-pause if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m in a slice. preflight alerting enabled. paging thresholds: >1% across any customer -> page oncall.

rebecca: protip for release notes: include clear 'how to pin' with API sample and mention SDK upgrade requirement. also add tenant outreach checklist for CS.

sdk-alex: SDK 1.4.2 will contain the proxy-compatible header handling and reassembly fix. ETA: build + canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC assuming CI passes. we'll backport 1.4.2 to 1.x branch.

product-lee: product OK with narrow canary pattern. request: when we re-run long-context tenants, limit to <=3 tenants per slice and notify tenant success.

mike: agree. before we hit midnight, let's ensure pin automation runbook is top of operator dashboard. quick pin flow should be <=45s end-to-end.

rebecca: prepping release notes draft: will add a Compatibility section and a short FAQ for tenants. will include the emergency pin curl sample.

ops-jen: pin sample command (ops token required):
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"tenant":"northstar","route":"/api","version":"v1","reason":"v2 stream partial responses","expires":"2026-04-02T00:00:00Z"}'
```

sanjay: who will monitor oncall during the ramp? we should have someone from runtime + SDK in the loop for first hour.

mike: I'll take the first 30m. tara can cover next. ops-jen onpager if thresholds hit. sdk-alex keep CI throttles on watch.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed at 23:20 UTC. healthy canary baseline ok. pin automation health: green.

00:02 UTC — ops-jen: alert: slice 2 (long-context cohort) 5xx 0.9% for 4m, auto-pause triggered.

deploy-bot: rollout paused for slice 2 at 00:02 UTC. traffic reverted to v1 for that slice.

mike: which tenants in slice 2?

deploy-bot: slice 2 tenants: northstar, atlas, peregrine. pinned: none.

rebecca: request immediate pin for northstar and peregrine. atlas is low traffic but include if needed.

ops-jen: applying pin now.

ops-jen: pinned northstar -> v1 (expires 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z). deploy-bot acknowledged in 22s. pinned peregrine -> v1, acked.

deploy-bot: pins applied. telemetry backfill shows northstar 5xx down to 0.04% after 3m.

sdk-alex: confirm SDK outreach immediately. we'll cut a hotfix branch for the reassembler and run narrow canary for long-context tenants only after patch bake.

tara: prefer hotfix that only touches reassembler; avoid touching header normalization unless we see broader failures.

product-lee: product approves narrow canary post-hotfix. require customer notification prior to re-run.

mike: rollback criteria reminder for release notes: if pinned tenants >10% of canary capacity OR any single tenant >1% 5xx for 5m -> schedule rollback window (30m) and page.

rebecca: added that to the release notes draft and the ops checklist. also flagged CS to email affected tenants with mitigation steps.

ops-jen: opened incident INC-2026-512 and assigned to oncall. created postmortem placeholder.

deploy-bot: monitoring update: slices resumed where safe; pinned tenants excluded from v2. overall canary health stable.

mike: action items: 1) SDK hotfix PR -> CI -> 2) cut 1.4.2 and mark in release notes 3) schedule narrow canary on long-context tenants only 4) tenant outreach by CS 5) postmortem if hotfix fails. I'll own 1 & 3.

rebecca: I'll finalize release notes and send to comms for the tenant email template.

sdk-alex: starting PR build now. will update in #sdk when green.

product-lee: thanks team. let's re-check at 03:30 UTC before any further ramp. :white_check_mark:
